outcome: Symphony Forge now has a knacklabs-upgrade-project operator skill (the forge upgrade sibling to knacklabs-migrate-project) that turns the constant, change-driven upgrade into one runbook: locate the harness robustly, upgrade the machinery, run the project audit + honest backfill, and guide a human through re-authoring only pending stories via forge roadmap fill (never import, never done stories), then re-verify. Every client command routes --repo TARGET so it never touches the harness. It composes the deterministic primitives so the honesty and safety live in the commands, not the prose.
